metadata.goal: Investigate how vessel characteristics are associated with route choice in the sea area.
metadata.category: vessel characteristics and offshore-versus-local route choice
metadata.header: West Jutland Vessel Characteristics and Route Choice
metadata.dataset_description: A constructed Danish AIS-style case with 100 complete waterborne trajectories in the North Sea west of Jutland. It contains a bidirectional offshore route and lower-volume connectors to Esbjerg, Hvide Sande, and Thyborøn, plus static vessel characteristics and route references.
metadata.source_note: The case uses Danish AIS-style fields and a real west-Jutland geographic context; all visible trajectories are constructed derived data.

insight_list.insight: Traffic is organized around one heavily used offshore transit route and several lower-volume routes connecting local harbours and coastal waters.

plot.title: West Jutland Route Traffic Structure
plot.description: Complete waterborne trajectories and counts distinguish the main offshore route from three harbour connectors.

insight_list.question: How is vessel traffic organized between the offshore corridor and local harbour routes?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Classify trajectories against the supplied route references and compare route-class counts.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
points=pd.read_csv(dataset_path); refs=pd.read_csv(Path('route_references.csv'))
print(points.groupby('trajectory_id').size().describe()); print(refs.groupby(['route_class','route_name']).size())

insight_list.insight: Larger cargo and tanker vessels are concentrated on the main offshore routes, while smaller vessels are more common on routes connected to local harbours.

plot.title: Vessel Characteristics by Route Class
plot.description: Vessel length is shown by ship type and inferred route class without using categorical size labels.

insight_list.question: How are vessel type and dimensions associated with offshore versus harbour-connected route use?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Link vessel attributes by vessel_id after assigning each trajectory to its nearest route reference.

insight_list.insight: On the main offshore route, cargo and tanker traffic follows the route closely, while fishing vessels show more spatially dispersed movement with moderate deviations from the route.

plot.title: Main-route Regularity by Vessel Type
plot.description: The map and offset distributions compare cargo/tanker and fishing trajectories assigned to the main offshore route; harbour-route fishing vessels are excluded by construction.

insight_list.question: On the main offshore route, does route regularity differ between cargo/tanker traffic and fishing vessels?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Restrict trajectories to the main offshore route, then measure mean distance from the nearest supplied route reference and compare vessel types.
